props.autoPlay: Scrolls the content on its own. Pass an object to set the `speed` in pixels per second and to `reverse` the travel direction. Left off, the content holds still while staying draggable and keyboard navigable.
props.mask: Fades the content out at both edges. Pass an object to set the gradient `size` in pixels and its `color`, which takes a theme colour or any CSS colour.
props.gap: Space between items. Also sets the seam between repeated copies, so both stay in step.
props.draggable: Allows scrubbing the content by dragging it with a pointer or finger.
props.shiftDistance: How far one arrow click moves the content. Accepts any CSS length; percentages resolve against the visible area.
props.showArrows: Displays navigation arrows over the content. Use `hover` to reveal them on pointer hover or keyboard focus.
props.prevIcon: Icon used by the arrow that moves towards the start.
props.nextIcon: Icon used by the arrow that moves towards the end.

slots.separator: Rendered after every item, including across the seam between repeated copies.
slots.prev: Replaces the arrow that moves towards the start.
slots.next: Replaces the arrow that moves towards the end.
